answer: Require each identity to buy a liveness bond from a competitive market of underwriters whose own reserve capital is slashed if anyone they insure is later unmasked as a sybil. Like a jeweler telling a genuine opal from paste, an underwriter stakes its own money on appraising you, so it refuses to cover correlated clusters whose behavior merely echoes a seat already on its books and prices every extra fake at a punitive, risk-weighted premium. A swarm drifting in on a zephyr of free keypairs finds no underwriter willing to cover it, and each unmasking burns the insurer that backed the fake.
